status: prospective; no v3 outcomes exist at creation
rationale: Retain every arm of the original four primary comparisons on the remaining 16 preselected bugs; the first eight bugs supplied v2 harness-debugging evidence. This is an amended follow-up, not the completed original nine-condition study.
inference: Exact paired McNemar in the four previously stated directions, Benjamini-Hochberg over all four. Freeze before v3 data. No optional stopping or selective extra trials.
notes: The exact serving revision remains to be captured on the H100 before generation; null is unknown, not a revision pin.
The two size tiers are not a representative sample of all LLVM bugs.
No full-factorial interaction claim is supported by six conditions.
